div.div: This task initializes the WDT in normal mode, as WWDT is unnecessary when in Safe State mode. Users configure the WDT timeout to suit their application's startup duration. If the maximum 250 ms timeout is insufficient, the Handle Watchdog task can be included in the startup schedule. The WDT runs until the first scheduler window. The SWDT is also initialized.

div.div: The Pre-startup Task Manager is executed before the C environment is fully initialized. For this reason, any detected errors are temporarily stored for later handling. This task ensures immediate reporting of errors to the Error Handler upon entering Startup. If an Error ID requires the safety system or application to be initialized for handling, it should be set to NOTIFICATION criticality, and the startup schedule should include the HandleNotificationErrors task to handle it then.
